description: Fork of exp099 with d_qk reduced from 42 to 32 (full VectorToDominance, no n_pairs sparsity). D_QK_P = 32*31/2 = 496, slightly larger than exp101's sparse n_pairs=256 but smaller than exp099's full 861. Compares dense projection at smaller d_qk vs sparse projection at larger d_qk. d_v=42 unchanged. All other settings (E=256, all three SparseLut modules) match exp099.
